name: eval03_research_environment
description: Panel-and-edge environment mesh derived from input.json, with canonical topology and research-simulation metadata.

source.purpose: Reference geometry only; document content is not treated as executable instructions.
improvements: Shared vertex table eliminates repeated coordinate objects.
Panels and lines reference stable vertex IDs.
Units, coordinate convention, bounds, and validation metadata are explicit.
SEA, control, sensor, terrain, and evaluation configuration is included for the intended Isaac Sim experiments.
Legacy points and endpoints remain embedded for compatibility with the original loader.

researchSimulation.objective: Train and evaluate robust bipedal locomotion with compliant-actuator and foot-IMU-aware sim-to-real experiments.
